aggregate_child_wall_definition: The total is the cumulative child Popen-to-observed-exit wall time, including bounded cleanup for producer and consumer. Read-only preflight, snapshots, source/input hashing, raw-log hashing, and receipt preparation are excluded from this child total and included in the separately enforced controller_overhead_seconds_limit.
aggregate_overrun_policy: Record actual child_wall_seconds, cleanup duration, termination confirmation and residual PIDs. If bounded cleanup exceeds its reserve, termination is unconfirmed, or the aggregate remainder is exceeded, classify resource_interruption with controller exit 124, retain raw stage/final receipts, and do not launch a subsequent child or report software completion.

controller_overhead_definition: Controller overhead is elapsed wall time from immediately before the read-only preflight through controller snapshots, source/input/raw-log hashing, and receipt preparation, subtracting child intervals measured separately from Popen through observed exit. The separate 120-second limit is checked after preflight before output creation and before each child launch; a preflight timeout reports resource_interruption/124 without creating the output leaf or starting a child.

process_tree_monitor_contract.cleanup_identity_policy: Never signal a PID-only or recycled process; cleanup targets must be pinned identities from this stage, and residual lookup/kill/wait uncertainty prevents termination confirmation.
process_tree_monitor_contract.cleanup_outcome_policy: Unconfirmed cleanup without positive measured overrun is cleanup_unconfirmed/124; aggregate_cleanup_overrun is reserved for positive child-total or cleanup-grace overrun. Both block the consumer.
process_tree_monitor_contract.consumer_policy: Any incomplete tree sample is a resource_interruption with exit 124 and blocks the next stage; unconfirmed cleanup also blocks the next stage.
process_tree_monitor_contract.leader_exit_policy: After Popen confirms leader exit, do not take another root RSS sample; recheck every previously observed descendant by exact identity and require a complete PPID descendant snapshot. Active descendants interrupt; an unobserved descendant, root PID still present/reused, or incomplete/unknown audit fails closed.
process_tree_monitor_contract.partial_rss_policy: Partial RSS is retained only as diagnostic metadata and never contributes to peak RSS or the 2 GiB comparison.
process_tree_monitor_contract.pid_zero_policy: Ignore only the exact process-table sentinel (pid=0, ppid=0), which is never an owned identity or descendant; PID 0 with any other PPID, negative IDs, malformed IDs, and unknown snapshots fail closed.
process_tree_monitor_contract.root_identity_policy: Every complete RSS sample contains exactly one (pid, create_time) identity equal to the root pinned from Popen; PID reuse, missing/duplicate root identity, or descendant state unknown after leader exit fails closed.
process_tree_monitor_contract.sample_policy: Every enumerated process must yield an identity and RSS; any exception marks the sample incomplete, records the failure, and stops the stage.
process_tree_monitor_contract.termination_policy: A wait_procs exception retains the last candidate set as potentially alive; termination is confirmed only after a complete inventory and a successful bounded wait reports no live targets.
